Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You study the creature’s gait and fire toward the place its next step will carry it, watching for the marks that movement leaves behind.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Target / range / shape
One visible creature within 8 squares.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
Gain one ordinary ranged weapon and one d8 ammunition bundle if absent; each Bulk 1. Check ammunition after every attack.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Attack

Study how it moves and place a ranged shot where it will be. Requires ranged weapon and ammunition; check supply after use.

Weak
3 physical damage.
Standard
3 physical damage; learn one visible sign useful for following its trail.
Strong
5 physical damage; gain the sign and apply Slowed 1.
